description: Source file implementing Lua bindings for CDataSource in the Unvanquished game, providing functions to build and read data sources via Lua scripts.

methods.name: CDataSource_Build
methods.description: Lua-exposed function to request building a data source with specified name and table.

methods.name: CDataSource_Read
methods.description: Lua-exposed function to read data from a specified data source and table, returning selected fields.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_RegisterLuaCDataSource
methods.description: Registers the CDataSource functions into Lua environment.
